cards.title: Physical thermal state and Fermi-Dirac occupation
cards.latex: \rho=(1-\langle n\rangle)aa^\dagger+\langle n\rangle a^\dagger a=(1+e^\nu)^{-1}e^{\nu a^\dagger a},\quad \langle n\rangle=(1+e^{\epsilon/T})^{-1}
cards.role: Defines every physical single-mode state and the complete Figure 1 curve.

checks.reason: The thermal density operator and occupation are explicit in the main text and Figure 1 caption.
n(x)+n(-x)=1, so positive and negative temperature branches meet at n=1/2.
epsilon/T to +infinity gives the vacuum and to -infinity gives the excited state.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate a stable logistic function on epsilon/T in [-6,6].

cards.title: Glauber P, Wigner W, and Husimi Q supernumbers
cards.latex: P=-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*,\quad W=1/2-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*,\quad Q=1-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*
cards.role: Provides the common Grassmann soul and the three bodies feeding all disorder measures.

checks.reason: The three Gaussian supernumber expressions are printed in the main text and derived in Supplement (d).
The coefficient of alpha alpha* is one, hence every Berezin integral equals one.
Q_B-W_B=W_B-P_B=1/2 for every occupation.

cards.numerical_form: Represent only the ordinary bodies as arrays; retain the common nilpotent soul symbolically.

cards.title: Fermionic phase-space majorization

source_refs.value: main Eqs. (7)-(11), source labels eq:MajorizationRelation through eq:ConcaveAverageIdentity

cards.role: Shows that the uncertainty hierarchy is determined completely by the bounded bodies.

checks.reason: The Taylor/Berezin identity and all P/W/Q majorization chains are explicit in the main text.
Because (alpha alpha*)^2=0, all Taylor terms beyond the first derivative vanish under Berezin integration.
The implementation verifies P_B in [-1,0], W_B in [-1/2,1/2], and Q_B in [0,1].

cards.numerical_form: Check body interval endpoints and the constant P-W-Q spacing on n in [0,1].

cards.title: Covariance determinants and second-moment uncertainty

source_refs.value: main second-moment section and source label eq:SMURs

cards.role: Generates all Figure 2(a) curves and exact lower bounds.

checks.reason: The covariance definition, determinant, and three uncertainty relations are printed in the main text.
det(sigma_y)=-1, hence det(z_B sigma_y)=-z_B^2.
Dense occupation-grid checks give minima -1, -1/4, and -1 for P, W, and Q.

cards.numerical_form: Square the three bodies and apply the common minus sign.

cards.title: Rényi and Shannon phase-space entropies

source_refs.value: main entropy section, source labels eq:RenyiEntropy and eq:RenyiEntropiesPhaseSpace

cards.role: Generates Figure 2(b-c), including the exact r=1 limit.

checks.reason: The Rényi definition, Berezin integral, and closed forms are explicit in the main text.
Integral |z|^r equals r|z_B|^(r-1), giving the stated logarithm.
L'Hopital gives lim_{r to 1} ln(r)/(1-r)=-1.
For the plotted orders 1/4,1/2,1,2,4, S_r(W) increases strictly with r away from its common singularity.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the order-dependent constant and subtract log absolute body; retain true +infinity at zero body.

cards.title: Entropy bounds and curve intersections
cards.role: Fixes the dashed uncertainty bounds and the n=1/4,1/2,3/4 crossing markers.

checks.reason: The bounds and crossing occupations are explicit in the main text and Figure 2 caption.
The maximum body magnitudes are 1 for P/Q and 1/2 for W.
Substitution gives P=W at n=1/4, P=Q at 1/2, and W=Q at 3/4 for both moment and entropy measures.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate exact bounds and analytic crossing coordinates; no fitted marker positions are used.
